name: How long does it take to install a new door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for door frame installation can vary based on the complexity of the project and the type of door. A standard interior door frame replacement might take a few hours for an experienced professional. Exterior door frames, especially if they involve removing an existing frame, modifying the opening, or installing a pre-hung unit, could take a half-day to a full day. Factors like existing damage, wall material, and trim work can also influence the timeline. We prioritize efficient and quality work for residents in the Bay Area.
